title: RAW: contextual nasal-stop clusters and geminate stops share a written doubled body
summary: Complete invented 22-unit writer with a finite set-valued reader. For fixed disjoint abstract segment pairs (N_j,T_j), simultaneously replace each original within-word N_j immediately before T_j by T_j. Other segments remain literal. NT and TT therefore collide, while N elsewhere remains distinct. No sound values, historical attestation, native fit or source language assigned.

design.mechanism: A writer uses the same doubled stop body for a homorganic nasal-plus-stop cluster and an underlying geminate stop. This is a proposed teaching convention, not a claim of an attested sound law or an attested script. It preserves source distinctions outside the explicitly neutralized context.
design.unit: Source document is a finite ordered list of nonempty segment words over an abstract alphabet A of exactly22 segment categories. Fix 1<=r<=11 disjoint ordered pairs (N_j,T_j); all2r categories distinct. Their nasal/stop interpretation would require independent phonological evidence before application. Unpaired segments are literal. No chosen real phoneme inventory is supplied.
design.physical_writer: Fix one bijection phi from A to the22 existing working units. For each source word x and each ORIGINAL position i, emit phi(T_j) iff x[i]=N_j and i+1 exists with x[i+1]=T_j; otherwise emit phi(x[i]). Apply once simultaneously, not repeatedly to newly written strings. Put one visible interword space between output groups. Document framing is supplied by explicit beginning/end; no hidden reset, quotation, control word, silent names or exceptional spellings.
design.reader: Invert phi to obtain y. At each position whose literal category is T_j and whose next written category is T_j, enumerate either T_j or N_j; every other position stays literal. Retain exactly those complete candidate words whose forward encoding equals y. Return the Cartesian product across words, without ranking or choosing a desired reading. This is finite, at most2^L candidates per L-segment word; an empty candidate set rejects the string. No dictionary/grammar is secretly supplied.
design.contrast: Distinct from freeUD literal expansion: a source segment changes its written body depending on its ORIGINAL successor, and TT genuinely has multiple preimages. Distinct from967/1012: no vowel class, arch count or default vowel. Distinct from1077/78: within-word mandatory source rule, not a claimed native r/l sandhi correlation.
design.prediction: For each fixed pair in decoded working labels, every visible adjacent N_j T_j must immediately be followed by another T_j. Thus word-final N_jT_j and N_jT_jX with X!=T_j are impossible. NT itself is NOT universally absent: NNT writes NTT. These restrictions are independently checkable for a proposed pair/key without assigning a word meaning.
design.image_characterization_proof: An output N remains an original N, so its next source symbol could not have been T. If the next written symbol is nevertheless T, it must have been N converted because its original successor was T. Therefore a third written T follows. Conversely every maximal output N-run followed by a T-run of length>=2 can be obtained by changing the FIRST T in that run back to N before encoding. All other positions may remain literal. Disjoint pair endpoints prevent interference between pair-specific constructions. This supplies a source-free necessary-and-sufficient output condition; no native evaluation performed.

design.information_cost: One fixed22-entry bijection plus r ordered pair declarations must be learned. Writer needs one-symbol lookahead and preserves exact segment count and word boundaries. Reader ambiguity is real, including lexical/name ambiguity; proper names are not magically recovered. The source object does not include spelling case, punctuation, stress or syllable boundaries unless already represented as source categories, so no such information is claimed preserved.
design.smallest_future_test: After separate selection, enumerate only candidate disjoint pair assignments satisfying the frozen output condition on an already admitted complete-word panel, retaining reader alternatives and rare/recurrent sensitivity. Such survival would be formal capacity only, not evidence for nasals/stops. A source-language test would additionally need independently supplied segment sequences and paired phonological categories; no new corpus or classifier selected here.
counterexamples_and_stops: An apparent NT can arise from NNT; the tempting absence-of-NT claim was rejected source-free before registration.
Any actual word-final NT or NTX with X!=T refutes that pair under the stipulated wholeword/unit contract; pair selection cannot call exceptions transcription errors.

The writer is deterministic per source word and preserves exact source segment length. It cannot rescue old fixed wholeword source-type shortages by offering extra aliases. Existing1202 and1358/1359 source-specific decisions remain; no assertion about all languages.
Known k/e/s freeUD expansion obstructions do not automatically cover this noninjective contextual mapping, but falling outside a theorem is not a source fit.
Any compatible pattern may be nonphonetic; source labels and historical motivation remain unbound. No natural-language inventory of exactly22 phonemes is asserted.
